items.canonicalEnglishName: Basil leaves, chopped
items.notes: Fresh basil foliage; picking, washing and chopping do not turn it into dried basil, pesto or a mixed herb blend.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Basil leaves, finely chopped
items.notes: Fresh basil foliage; picking, washing and chopping do not turn it into dried basil, pesto or a mixed herb blend.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Boiling water, as needed for pouring over mackerel
items.notes: Plain water remains the ingredient; sauce/slurry/gelatin/covering wording describes its intended use rather than an already-mixed liquid. Do not substitute stock, soaking liquid, sweetened water or prepared sauce.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Broccoli, separated into small florets and washed
items.notes: Broccoli specifically separated into washed florets; select raw flower clusters, not stalks, leaves or cooked broccoli.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Brown onion, peeled and thinly sliced
items.notes: Bulb onion with slicing, peeling or chopping only; use generic raw onion, not breaded onion rings, onion bread, powder or cooked onion.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Bunch of parsley, washed and chopped
items.notes: Parsley foliage, washed/picked/chopped or served fresh; select fresh parsley, not parsley root, dried parsley or mixed herbs.

items.canonicalEnglishName: C - Cabbage (core removed, cut into 5–7 mm pieces)
items.notes: Green/white common cabbage leaves with cutting/washing only; select raw green cabbage, not Chinese cabbage, red cabbage, fermented cabbage or cooked leaves.

items.canonicalEnglishName: C- cinnamon powder, a little
items.notes: Explicit cinnamon powder, not a whole spice blend or cinnamon-flavoured bread; ground cinnamon matches the stated form.
